note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration dictionary (model = dict(...)) with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines architecture settings for Cascade R-CNN with ResNet-50-FPN backbone using imported MMDetection components.
summarize_model_config: summarize the Cascade R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN model configuration dictionary and its architecture settings

test_rcnn_train_cfg: test the R-CNN training configuration with MaxIoUAssigner thresholds across 3 cascade stages
